brief_rule: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy; each brief names the trait kept and the trait changed. Restricted donor: category-level only, no instance-level looks.
inspiration: Combo chain with a timed input window and a pre-input buffer: a press inside the window is remembered and fires at the next hit boundary; a press after the window is refused. For rows 3 and 5. Files: source/GameLib/ActorInstanceBattle.cpp lines 156-253.

Dropped early input in the fallback path: a motion without input-window data accepts the next hit only after most of the swing, and an earlier press is not stored. Idea kept (gate on swing progress); defect fixed in ours by buffering the early press. File: ActorInstanceBattle.cpp lines 199-209.

Normal-attack gate on swing progress: a fresh swing is accepted only when the current one is nearly done, or when the actor is waiting. For row 4 and row 5. File: ActorInstanceBattle.cpp lines 457-468.
Ranged mode keeps a late press as a next-attack request, run when the current motion ends. For row 13 (specials) with bow-like weapons. File: ActorInstanceBattle.cpp lines 180-181 and 242-251.

Swing progress as elapsed time times a per-actor speed ratio, with an older attack-speed term commented out. For row 6 (hero actor and animation): one ratio per motion. Files: ActorInstanceBattle.cpp lines 451-455; ActorInstance.cpp line 181.
Battle hit effect selected by an id on the actor (SetBattleHitEffect). For rows 8 and 10 (blood and hit impact): an effect id on the hit record. File: ActorInstanceBattle.cpp line 8.

briefs.label: Chain-swing window
briefs.why: A multi-hit swing chain where a press in the late part of each swing queues the next hit gives a rhythm that rewards timing without needing a perfect press. It reads at 375 wide because the chain is one character moving in one direction.
briefs.keep: Input-window buffer: a press inside the window is queued, and fires at the next hit boundary.
briefs.change: Our window is shorter at the start of a chain and longer on the last hit; the queue holds one press only; each hit adds a short recovery that the chain cannot skip.

briefs.label: Late-press keeper for ranged attacks
briefs.why: A ranged attack that holds a late press until the shot ends stops the bow feeling unresponsive, without making the ranged action fire on every press.
briefs.keep: A press after the window is kept as a next-attack request and run when the motion ends.
briefs.change: Keep only the most recent press; cancel the kept press if the target leaves the line; show it as a small ring at the hero's feet.

briefs.label: Attack gate on swing progress
briefs.why: Accepting a new swing only near the end of the last one makes each blow visible and avoids overlapping animations, which helps a crowd fight stay readable.
briefs.keep: A gate on swing progress for normal attacks; accepted when the actor is idle.
briefs.change: Buffer early presses instead of dropping them (our fix); set the gate per weapon class, not one value for all.

briefs.label: Per-motion speed ratio
briefs.why: Driving an animation by elapsed time times one ratio lets speed changes (slow, fast) apply to a single motion without rewriting the clip.
briefs.keep: Elapsed time times a per-motion ratio; the actor sets the ratio, not the clip.
briefs.change: The ratio comes from our engine's attack-speed value per hero, not from a separate function; no commented-out path kept.

briefs.label: Hit effect by id
briefs.why: A hit effect chosen by an id on the hit record lets one hit type look different per target without a new code path.
briefs.keep: Effect id on the hit record; the actor sets it before the hit lands.
briefs.change: Our effect ids are per damage class (cut, blunt, arrow), with our own particle style; no copy of any effect table.

defects_found.defect: In the fallback branch an early press is neither fired nor stored (no pre-input is set), so the input is lost.
defects_found.fix: store the early press as a pre-input and fire it at the same boundary as the timed branch.
